title: Do Large Language Models Know Folktales? A Case Study of Yokai in Japanese Folktales

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM performance on YokaiEval, a custom multiple-choice benchmark dataset consisting of 809 questions designed to probe knowledge of Japanese folktales (Yokai). The study compares the cultural awareness of English-centric models against Japanese-centric and other multilingual models to measure disparities in regional cultural knowledge.
